more_info.overview: Potassium sulphite is an inorganic potassium salt in the sulphite preservative and antioxidant family. Its preservative function is to limit microbial spoilage during storage. The available identity record does not establish a typical retail-food example for this exact preparation. Commercial specifications and legal conditions need to refer to the particular substance or preparation named here.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-0.7 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 1998). The JECFA group limit is expressed as sulphur dioxide equivalents.
